#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ATDD-MIN-1 verification wrapper. Runs the capsule's focused verification and
# records wall-clock command runtime to a ledger outside the repository, so
# active agent time can be separated from test-command runtime symmetrically
# across both arms.
set -uo pipefail

LEDGER="${ATDD_VERIFY_LEDGER:-/dev/null}"
export DB_CONNECTION=mysql
export DB_HOST=127.0.0.1
export DB_PORT=3306
export DB_USERNAME=root
export DB_DATABASE="${ATDD_TEST_DB:-jakomeet_testing}"
unset DB_PASSWORD

start=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')
php artisan test --without-tty "$@"
status=$?
end=$(python3 -c 'import time;print(time.time())')

python3 - "$LEDGER" "$start" "$end" "$status" "$*" <<'PY'
import json, sys
ledger, start, end, status, argv = sys.argv[1], float(sys.argv[2]), float(sys.argv[3]), int(sys.argv[4]), sys.argv[5]
if ledger != "/dev/null":
    with open(ledger, "a") as fh:
        fh.write(json.dumps({"start": start, "end": end, "seconds": round(end - start, 3), "status": status, "args": argv}) + "\n")
PY

exit $status

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Modules\Events\Enums\AutomationType;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\AutomationConfigurationController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\EventController;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\LandingPreview;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\LandingSetup;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\RegistrationFormConfig;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Http\Controllers\RoleActionController;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Http\Controllers\UserActionController;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Http\Controllers\WorkspaceActionController;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\AiAuditQueueIndex;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\AiAuditRequestShow;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\AuditLogsIndex;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\Dashboard;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\EventsIndex;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\PlatformKillSwitches;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\PrivacyErasure;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\RolesIndex;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\SupportTicketQueueIndex;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\SupportTicketShow;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\UserShow;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\UsersIndex;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\WorkspaceShow;
use App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Livewire\WorkspacesIndex;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

$middlewares = ['web', 'auth:web', 'verified'];
if (config('jetstream.auth_session')) {
    array_splice($middlewares, 2, 0, config('jetstream.auth_session'));
}

Route::middleware($middlewares)
    ->prefix('admin')
    ->name('admin.')
    ->group(function (): void {
        Route::get('/dashboard', Dashboard::class)->name('dashboard');
        Route::get('/events', EventsIndex::class)->name('events.index');
        Route::get('/operations/kill-switches', PlatformKillSwitches::class)->name('operations.kill-switches');
        Route::get('/privacy/erasure', PrivacyErasure::class)->name('privacy.erasure');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}', [EventController::class, 'show'])
            ->whereUuid('event')
            ->name('events.show');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}/edit', [EventController::class, 'edit'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.edit');
        Route::patch('/events/{event:uuid}', [EventController::class, 'update'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.update');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}/landing', LandingSetup::class)->whereUuid('event')->name('events.landing.edit');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}/landing/preview', LandingPreview::class)->whereUuid('event')->name('events.landing.preview');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}/form-config', RegistrationFormConfig::class)->whereUuid('event')->name('events.form-config.edit');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}/automations', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'show'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.automations.show');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/automations', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'update'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.automations.update');
        Route::patch('/events/{event:uuid}/automations/{type}/status', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'toggle'])
            ->whereUuid('event')
            ->whereIn('type', AutomationType::values())
            ->name('events.automations.toggle');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}/automations/{type}', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'detail'])
            ->whereUuid('event')
            ->whereIn('type', AutomationType::values())
            ->name('events.automations.detail');
        Route::get('/events/{event:uuid}/prepare', [EventController::class, 'prepareRedirect'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.prepare');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/publish', [EventController::class, 'publish'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.publish');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/cancel', [EventController::class, 'cancel'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.cancel');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/suspend', [EventController::class, 'suspend'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.suspend');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/reactivate', [EventController::class, 'reactivate'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.reactivate');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/force-end', [EventController::class, 'forceEnd'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.force-end');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/lock-publishing', [EventController::class, 'lockPublishing'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.lock-publishing');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/unlock-publishing', [EventController::class, 'unlockPublishing'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.unlock-publishing');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/lock-go-live', [EventController::class, 'lockGoLive'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.lock-go-live');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/unlock-go-live', [EventController::class, 'unlockGoLive'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.unlock-go-live');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/streaming-assets/retry-replay', [EventController::class, 'retryReplayAsset'])->whereUuid('event')->name('events.streaming-assets.retry-replay');
        Route::post('/events/{event:uuid}/streaming-assets/retry-stage/{stage}', [EventController::class, 'retryReplayStage'])
            ->whereUuid('event')
            ->whereIn('stage', ['finalization', 'ingestion', 'publication', 'transcript', 'cleanup', 'retention'])
            ->name('events.streaming-assets.retry-stage');
        Route::get('/users', UsersIndex::class)->name('users.index');
        // Static segment must precede dynamic {userUuid} to prevent shadowing, even though
        // the UUID constraint on {userUuid} already excludes the literal string "create".
        // Declaring static routes first is the conventional and safest ordering.
        Route::get('/users/create', [UserActionController::class, 'create'])->name('users.create');
        // Story 1-11C D1 — dedicated edit page (AC2 GET precondition, AC11)
        Route::get('/users/{userUuid}/edit', [UserActionController::class, 'edit'])->whereUuid('userUuid')->name('users.edit');
        Route::get('/users/{userUuid}', UserShow::class)
            ->whereUuid('userUuid')
            ->name('users.show');
        // Email-based alias: redirect /admin/users/{email} → /admin/users/{uuid}
        Route::get('/users/{email}', [UserActionController::class, 'showByEmail'])
            ->where('email', '.+@.+')
            ->name('users.show-by-email');
        // Story 1-11C — user administration (mutations)
        // All mutation routes use {userUuid} (uuid-constrained) for consistency with read
        // routes. The controller resolves uuid → User via findUserByUuidForMutation.
        Route::post('/users', [UserActionController::class, 'store'])->name('users.store');
        Route::post('/users/{userUuid}/update', [UserActionController::class, 'update'])->whereUuid('userUuid')->name('users.update');
        Route::post('/users/{userUuid}/grant-system-admin', [UserActionController::class, 'grantSystemAdmin'])->whereUuid('userUuid')->name('users.grant-system-admin');
        Route::post('/users/{userUuid}/revoke-system-admin', [UserActionController::class, 'revokeSystemAdmin'])->whereUuid('userUuid')->name('users.revoke-system-admin');
        Route::post('/users/{userUuid}/disable', [UserActionController::class, 'disable'])->whereUuid('userUuid')->name('users.disable');
        Route::post('/users/{userUuid}/enable', [UserActionController::class, 'enable'])->whereUuid('userUuid')->name('users.enable');
        Route::get('/teams', WorkspacesIndex::class)->name('teams.index');
        Route::get('/teams/{teamUuid}', WorkspaceShow::class)
            ->whereUuid('teamUuid')
            ->name('teams.show');
        Route::get('/teams/{teamUuid}/{section}', WorkspaceShow::class)
            ->whereUuid('teamUuid')
            ->whereIn('section', ['members', 'billing-adjustments', 'audit', 'operations', 'automations', 'delivery-failures'])
            ->name('teams.section');
        Route::post('/teams/{team}/suspend', [WorkspaceActionController::class, 'suspend'])->name('teams.suspend');
        Route::post('/teams/{team}/reactivate', [WorkspaceActionController::class, 'reactivate'])->name('teams.reactivate');
        Route::post('/teams/{team}/transfer-ownership', [WorkspaceActionController::class, 'transferOwnership'])->name('teams.transfer-ownership');
        Route::post('/teams/{team}/subscription/credit', [WorkspaceActionController::class, 'applyCredit'])->name('teams.subscription.credit');
        Route::post('/teams/{team}/subscription/refund', [WorkspaceActionController::class, 'processRefund'])->name('teams.subscription.refund');
        Route::post('/teams/{team}/subscription/external-refund', [WorkspaceActionController::class, 'recordExternalRefund'])->name('teams.subscription.external-refund');
        Route::post('/teams/{team}/subscription/adjustments/{adjustment}/void', [WorkspaceActionController::class, 'voidAdjustment'])->name('teams.subscription.adjustment.void');
        Route::get('/audit-logs', AuditLogsIndex::class)->name('audit-logs.index');
        Route::get('/support-tickets', SupportTicketQueueIndex::class)->name('support-tickets.index');
        Route::get('/support-tickets/{supportTicket}', SupportTicketShow::class)->whereUuid('supportTicket')->name('support-tickets.show');
        Route::get('/ai-audit', AiAuditQueueIndex::class)->name('ai-audit.index');
        Route::get('/ai-audit/{auditRequest:uuid}', AiAuditRequestShow::class)->name('ai-audit.show');
        Route::get('/roles', RolesIndex::class)->name('roles.index');
        // Story 1-11D — role & permission administration
        Route::get('/roles/{roleUuid}', [RoleActionController::class, 'show'])->whereUuid('roleUuid')->name('roles.show');
        Route::post('/roles/{roleUuid}/permissions', [RoleActionController::class, 'updatePermissions'])->whereUuid('roleUuid')->name('roles.update-permissions');
    });

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\Traits\PermissionTesting;
use Tests\Traits\TeamTesting;

/**
 * Base class for feature tests
 * 
 * Feature tests validate HTTP requests, routes, and full application workflows.
 * They test the application from the outside-in, simulating real user interactions.
 */
abstract class FeatureTestCase extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;
    use PermissionTesting;
    use TeamTesting;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        // RefreshDatabase wipes the permissions table every test, so we reseed
        // when it's empty. The old `$permissionsSeeded` static was dead code
        // (set but never read) and misleadingly suggested per-class caching
        // that couldn't work under RefreshDatabase. Removed 2026-04-23 per
        // test-review-1-3 isolation finding.
        $this->seedPermissionsOnce();
    }
    
    /**
     * Seed permissions only once per test run to avoid redundant seeding
     */
    protected function seedPermissionsOnce(): void
    {
        // Check if permissions table is empty (RefreshDatabase clears it)
        if (\App\Models\RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Shortcut: create an email-verified user. Targets the 25+ repetitions
     * of `User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()])` across
     * Epic 1 suites (test-review-1-3 Maintainability finding).
     */
    protected function verifiedUser(array $attributes = []): \App\Models\User
    {
        return \App\Models\User::factory()->create(array_merge(
            ['email_verified_at' => now()],
            $attributes,
        ));
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\Authz\Http;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Authenticatable;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class RouteCapabilityMiddleware
{
    private const REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE = 'platform_authz.route_capability_evaluated';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly RouteRequirementResolver $resolver,
    ) {}

    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        if ($request->attributes->get(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE) === true) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $request->attributes->set(self::REQUEST_EVALUATED_ATTRIBUTE, true);

        $routeName = $request->route()?->getName();

        if (!$routeName) {
            abort(403, 'Route must be named for permission checks.');
        }

        $requirement = $this->resolver->resolve($routeName);

        // A protected named route without an explicit route-permission mapping is a
        // configuration error. Fail closed rather than silently widening access.
        if ($requirement === null) {
            abort(403, 'Route permission mapping is missing for this route.');
        }

        // Public routes bypass all auth/capability checks — the route is
        // open to all visitors, authenticated or not.
        if ($requirement->type === RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC) {
            return $next($request);
        }

        $user = $request->user();

        if (!$user) {
            abort(403, 'Authentication required.');
        }

        if (!$this->evaluate($requirement, $user)) {
            abort(403, 'You do not have permission to access this route.');
        }

        return $next($request);
    }

    public function evaluate(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return match ($requirement->type) {
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_PUBLIC => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_NONE => true,
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SINGLE => $this->evaluateSingle($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ANY_OF => $this->evaluateAnyOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_ALL_OF => $this->evaluateAllOf($requirement, $user),
            RouteRequirement::TYPE_SPECIAL => $this->evaluateSpecial($requirement, $user),
            default => false,
        };
    }

    private function evaluateSingle(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        return Gate::forUser($user)->allows($requirement->capabilities[0]);
    }

    private function evaluateAnyOf(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        foreach ($requirement->capabilities as $capability) {
            if (Gate::forUser($user)->allows($capability)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    private function evaluateAllOf(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        foreach ($requirement->clauses as $clause) {
            if (!$this->evaluate($clause, $user)) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function evaluateSpecial(RouteRequirement $requirement, Authenticatable $user): bool
    {
        $method = $requirement->specialMethod;
        if ($method === null || !method_exists($user, $method)) {
            return false;
        }
        return (bool) $user->$method();
    }
}

class EventsIndexTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use BillingTestFixtures;
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 — events index accessible to SYSTEM_ADMIN, denied to others
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('2-6a-EVENTS-01 [P0] Given a SYSTEM_ADMIN when they navigate to /admin/events then a 200 is returned')]
    public function super_admin_can_access_events_index(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $admin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('admin.events.index'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-testid="filter-workspace"', false);

namespace Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support;

use App\Enums\TeamStatus;
use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\RolePermission;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;

trait InteractsWithSuperAdmin
{
    /**
     * Ensure roles + permissions are seeded before each test.
     *
     * Tests using this trait may extend TestCase directly (not FeatureTestCase)
     * and therefore do not call seedPermissionsOnce() in their own setUp.
     * The count guard prevents double-seeding when a test also inherits from
     * FeatureTestCase (which already calls the same seeder).
     *
     * Added by Story 1-11C for UserAdministrationTest.
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();

        if (RolePermission::count() === 0) {
            $this->seed(\Database\Seeders\Testing\TestPermissionSeeder::class);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Create the platform's is_system_team team for tests that exercise the
     * grantSystemAdmin / revokeSystemAdmin service paths.
     *
     * The production system team is seeded by SuperadminSeeder; in tests with
     * RefreshDatabase it must be created explicitly before calling the grant
     * service method.
     */
    protected function createSystemTeam(): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);

        /** @var Team $team */
        $team = Team::factory()->create([
            'user_id'         => $owner->id,
            'is_system_team'  => true,
            'personal_team'   => false,
        ]);

        return $team;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $teamAttributes
     */
    protected function createWorkspace(array $teamAttributes = []): Team
    {
        $owner = User::factory()->create(['email_verified_at' => now()]);
        /** @var Team $team */
        $team = Team::factory()
            ->nonPersonal()
            ->create(array_merge(['user_id' => $owner->id], $teamAttributes));

        $team->users()->attach($owner, ['role' => UserRole::ownerDefault()->value]);
        $owner->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        /** @var Team $freshTeam */
        $freshTeam = $team->fresh(['owner', 'users']);

        return $freshTeam;
    }

    protected function createPlatformSuperAdmin(?Team $team = null): User
    {
        $workspace = $team ?? $this->createWorkspace();
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $workspace->id,
        ]);

        $workspace->users()->attach($user, ['role' => UserRole::SYSTEM_ADMIN->value]);

        /** @var User $freshUser */
        $freshUser = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        return $freshUser;
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<string, mixed>  $attributes
     */
    protected function createWorkspaceMember(Team $team, UserRole $role, array $attributes = []): User
    {
        /** @var User $user */
        $user = User::factory()->create(array_merge([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $team->id,
        ], $attributes));

        $team->users()->attach($user, ['role' => $role->value]);

        /** @var User $freshUser */
        $freshUser = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        return $freshUser;
    }

    protected function suspendWorkspace(Team $team): Team
    {
        $team->forceFill(['status' => TeamStatus::SUSPENDED])->save();

        /** @var Team $freshTeam */
        $freshTeam = $team->fresh();

        return $freshTeam;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Platform\Authz\Core;

use InvalidArgumentException;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Container\Container;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Contracts\CapabilityCheckerInterface;
use Platform\Authz\Core\Contracts\CapabilityRegistrarInterface;

class GateCapabilityRegistrar implements CapabilityRegistrarInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly CapabilityCheckerInterface $capabilityChecker,
        private readonly ?Container $container = null,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * Register capability-based authorization with Laravel's Gate.
     *
     * Hooks into Gate::before to intercept capability checks and delegate
     * to the CapabilityChecker for actual permission evaluation.
     *
     * CRITICAL: Returns null for non-capability strings to preserve existing
     * policy behavior. Only handles 3-dot-separated capability strings.
     *
     * @return void
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        Gate::before(function ($user, string $ability, array $arguments = []) {
            if ($user === null || !$this->isCapabilityString($ability)) {
                return null;
            }

            if ($arguments !== []) {
                throw new InvalidArgumentException(
                    'Capability gates do not accept resource arguments. Use a policy ability for resource-aware authorization.'
                );
            }

            return $this->resolveCapabilityChecker()->hasCapability($user, $ability);
        });
    }

    private function resolveCapabilityChecker(): CapabilityCheckerInterface
    {
        if ($this->container && $this->container->bound(CapabilityCheckerInterface::class)) {
            return $this->container->make(CapabilityCheckerInterface::class);
        }

        return $this->capabilityChecker;
    }

    private function isCapabilityString(string $ability): bool
    {
        if ($ability === '' || preg_match('/\s/', $ability)) {
            return false;
        }

        $segments = explode('.', $ability);

        if (count($segments) !== 3) {
            return false;
        }

        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if ($segment === '') {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Role;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;

/**
 * Story 1.5 Round 2 — assigns tenant capabilities to existing roles.
 *
 * Shares its logic with the `2026_04_21_000001_story_1_5_grant_tenant_capabilities`
 * migration. The migration covers production (roles already seeded); this
 * seeder covers the fresh-install / test-database path where migrations run
 * BEFORE roles exist.
 */
class Story15CapabilitySeeder extends Seeder
{
    /**
     * Role → permission grants, keyed by UserRole enum case.
     *
     * @var array<string, list<string>>
     */
    private const ROLE_PERMISSIONS = [
        // Platform super-admin — holds global variants only.
        'SYSTEM_ADMIN' => [
            'billing.manage.global',
            'billing.view.global',
            'billing.update.global',
            'billing.credit.global',
            'billing.refund.global',
            'billing.void_adjustment.global',
            'automations.manage.global',
            'automations.view.global',
            'events.view.global',
            'events.create.global',      // Story 2-1 R1 — defensive global bypass for cross-team Super Admin tooling
            'events.suspend.global',     // Story 2-6
            'events.force_end.global',   // Story 2-6
            'events.publish.global',     // Story 2-3b R1
            'events.cancel.global',      // Story 2-5 R1
            'events.backstage_key.global', // Story 5-4a — SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team key management
            'teams.update.global',
            'teams.suspend.global',
            'teams.transfer_ownership.global',
            'workspace_settings.view.global',
            'go_live.perform.global',
        ],
        // jakomeet team Administrator.
        'ADMIN' => [
            'billing.manage.team',
            'billing.view.team',
            'billing.update.team',
            'automations.manage.team',
            'automations.view.team',
            'events.view.team',
            'events.create.team',
            'events.update.team',
            'events.publish.team',     // Story 2-3b R1 — Admin only (Co-host CANNOT publish per AC5)
            'events.cancel.team',      // Story 2-5 R1 — Admin only per story 2-5
            'events.backstage_key.team', // Story 5-4a — Admin-only guest key management
            'teams.update.team',
            'workspace_settings.view.team',
            'workspace_settings.update.team',
            'go_live.perform.team',
        ],
        // jakomeet Billing Admin — billing-focused only.
        'BILLING_ADMIN' => [
            'billing.manage.team',
            'billing.view.team',
            'billing.update.team',
        ],
        // jakomeet Co-host — collaborator. Story 2-1 grants `events.create.team`
        // because Story 2.1 ACs say Admin OR Co-host may create events.
        'CO_HOST' => [
            'automations.view.team',
            'events.view.team',
            'events.create.team',
            'events.update.team',
        ],
    ];

    public function run(): void
    {
        foreach (self::ROLE_PERMISSIONS as $roleCase => $permissions) {
            $fqcn = UserRole::class."::{$roleCase}";
            if (! defined($fqcn)) {
                continue;
            }
            /** @var UserRole $enum */
            $enum = constant($fqcn);
            $role = Role::where('key', $enum->value)->first();
            if (! $role) {
                continue;
            }

            foreach ($permissions as $permission) {
                $role->assignPermission($permission);
            }
        }
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Traits;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Platform\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantContextInterface;

trait BelongsToTeam
{
    /**
     * Get the team that owns this model.
     */
    public function team(): BelongsTo
    {
        return $this->belongsTo(Team::class);
    }

    /**
     * Scope to filter records by specific team
     *
     * @param Builder $query
     * @param Team $team
     * @return Builder
     */
    public function scopeForTeam(Builder $query, Team $team): Builder
    {
        return $query->where("team_id", $team->id);
    }

    /**
     * Scope to filter records for current user's team
     *
     * @param Builder $query
     * @return Builder
     */
    public function scopeForCurrentTeam(Builder $query): Builder
    {
        $tenantContext = app(TenantContextInterface::class);
        $tenantId = $tenantContext->getTenantId();

        if ($tenantId !== null) {
            return $query->where("team_id", $tenantId);
        }
        return $query->whereRaw('1=0');
    }

    /**
     * Check if this model belongs to the given team
     */
    public function belongsToTeam(Team $team): bool
    {
        return $this->team_id === $team->id;
    }

    /**
     * Boot method to automatically assign team_id when creating new records
     */
    protected static function bootBelongsToTeam(): void
    {
        // Auto-assign team when creating records
        static::creating(function ($model) {
            $tenantContext = app(TenantContextInterface::class);
            $tenantId = $tenantContext->getTenantId();

            if ($tenantId !== null) {

<?php

namespace Platform\Tenancy;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Platform\Tenancy\Contracts\TenantContextInterface;

/**
 * JetstreamTenantContext
 * 
 * Jetstream-coupled implementation of tenant context.
 * Resolves tenant from the authenticated user's currentTeam property.
 * 
 * V1 Implementation Notes:
 * - Relies on host app's User model (via Auth::user() facade)
 * - Assumes Jetstream's currentTeam relationship exists
 * - Delegates bypass logic to User::shouldBypassTeamScope()
 * - Request-scoped binding ensures consistent tenant context per request
 * 
 * @package Platform\Tenancy
 */
class JetstreamTenantContext implements TenantContextInterface
{
    /**
     * Get the current tenant ID for the request.
     * 
     * Returns the authenticated user's currentTeam ID.
     * Returns null if:
     * - No user is authenticated
     * - User has no currentTeam set
     * 
     * @return int|null The current tenant ID, or null if no tenant context exists
     */
    public function getTenantId(): ?int
    {
        // Check if user is authenticated
        if (!Auth::check()) {
            return null;
        }

        // Get authenticated user via framework facade (portable, no host-app helper)
        $user = Auth::user();

        // Ensure user has currentTeam relationship loaded
        if (!$user || !$user->currentTeam) {
            return null;
        }

        return $user->currentTeam->id;
    }

    /**
     * Determine if the current user should bypass tenant scope restrictions.
     * 
     * Delegates to the host app's User::shouldBypassTeamScope() method.
     * This preserves existing bypass logic (system admin check).
     * 
     * Returns false if:
     * - No user is authenticated
     * - User is not an instance of the host app User model
     * 
     * @return bool True if tenant scope should be bypassed, false otherwise
     */
    public function shouldBypassTenantScope(): bool
    {
        // No authenticated user - don't bypass
        if (!Auth::check()) {
            return false;
        }

        $user = Auth::user();

        // Ensure we have a User model instance with the shouldBypassTeamScope method
        if (!$user || !method_exists($user, 'shouldBypassTeamScope')) {
            return false;
        }

        // Delegate to existing host-app logic
        return $user->shouldBypassTeamScope();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Services;

use App\Authz\EntitlementChecker;
use App\Enums\PlanEntitlement;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Models\AiEventEngagementSummary;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Models\AiEventInterestSignal;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Models\AiEventPostEventOverview;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Services\AiPostEventOverviewService;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Services\AiTranscriptService;
use App\Modules\Engagement\Models\EngagementPoll;
use App\Modules\Engagement\Models\EngagementQuestion;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventExportType;
use App\Modules\Events\Exceptions\PlanGateFailed;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

class EventExportService
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntitlementChecker $entitlements,
        private readonly AiTranscriptService $transcripts,
        private readonly AiPostEventOverviewService $overviews,
        private readonly EventAuthorizationService $authorization,
    ) {}

    /**
     * @return array{filename: string, rows: list<list<string>>}
     */
    public function build(Event $event, User $actor, EventExportType $type): array
    {
        $this->authorization->authorizeView($event, $actor);

        $eventBoundAiExport = $type === EventExportType::AI_OUTPUTS
            && $this->transcripts->authorizedForEvent($event);
        if (! $eventBoundAiExport
            && ! $this->entitlements->hasFreshEntitlementForTeam(
                $actor,
                $event->team_id,
                PlanEntitlement::EXPORTS,
            )) {
            throw PlanGateFailed::for($event, PlanEntitlement::EXPORTS->value);
        }

        return [
            'filename' => sprintf('%s-%s.csv', $this->safeFilenameStem($event), $type->value),
            'rows' => match ($type) {
                EventExportType::REGISTRANTS => $this->registrantRows($event, attendeesOnly: false),
                EventExportType::ATTENDEES => $this->registrantRows($event, attendeesOnly: true),
                EventExportType::QUESTIONS => $this->questionRows($event),
                EventExportType::POLLS => $this->pollRows($event),
                EventExportType::AI_OUTPUTS => $this->aiOutputRows($event, $actor),
            },
        ];
    }

    public function response(Event $event, User $actor, EventExportType $type): StreamedResponse
    {
        $export = $this->build($event, $actor, $type);

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($export): void {
            $handle = fopen('php://output', 'wb');
            if ($handle === false) {
                return;
            }

            foreach ($export['rows'] as $row) {
                fputcsv($handle, $row, escape: '\\');
            }

            fclose($handle);
        }, $export['filename'], [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function registrantRows(Event $event, bool $attendeesOnly): array
    {
        $query = Registration::query()
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id');

        if ($attendeesOnly) {
            $query->whereNotNull('attended_at');
        }

        $rows = [$this->headers($attendeesOnly ? EventExportType::ATTENDEES : EventExportType::REGISTRANTS)];

        /** @var Collection<int, Registration> $registrations */
        $registrations = $query->get();
        foreach ($registrations as $index => $registration) {
            $rows[] = [
                (string) ($index + 1),
                (string) $registration->full_name,
                (string) ($registration->company ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->title ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->country ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->industry ?? ''),
                (string) $registration->source,
                $registration->attended_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',
                $registration->created_at->toIso8601String(),
            ];
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function questionRows(Event $event): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers(EventExportType::QUESTIONS)];

        EngagementQuestion::query()
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get()
            ->each(function (EngagementQuestion $question, int $index) use (&$rows): void {
                $rows[] = [
                    (string) ($index + 1),
                    $question->state->value,
                    $question->is_pinned ? 'yes' : 'no',
                    (string) $question->body,
                    $question->created_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',
                ];
            });

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function pollRows(Event $event): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers(EventExportType::POLLS)];

        EngagementPoll::query()
            ->with(['options' => fn ($query) => $query->withCount('votes')])
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get()
            ->each(function (EngagementPoll $poll) use (&$rows): void {
                foreach ($poll->options as $option) {
                    $rows[] = [
                        (string) $poll->id,
                        $poll->state->value,
                        (string) $poll->question,
                        (string) $option->ordinal,
                        (string) $option->label,
                        (string) ($option->votes_count ?? 0),
                    ];
                }
            });

        return $rows;
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    private function aiOutputRows(Event $event, User $actor): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers(EventExportType::AI_OUTPUTS)];

        if ($this->transcripts->authorizedForEvent($event)) {
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow(
                'transcript',
                $this->transcripts->forEvent($event),
                'transcript_text',
            );
        }

        if ($this->hasEntitlement($actor, $event, PlanEntitlement::AI_INSIGHTS)) {
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow('engagement_summary', AiEventEngagementSummary::query()->where('event_id', $event->id)->first(), 'summary');
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow('interest_signals', AiEventInterestSignal::query()->where('event_id', $event->id)->first(), 'signals');
        }

        if ($this->overviews->authorizedForEvent($event)) {
            $rows[] = $this->aiRow(
                'post_event_overview',
                AiEventPostEventOverview::query()
                    ->where('team_id', $event->team_id)
                    ->where('event_id', $event->id)
                    ->first(),
                'overview',
            );
        }

        return array_values(array_filter($rows, fn (array $row): bool => $row !== []));
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function aiRow(string $outputType, ?Model $record, string $payloadField): array
    {
        if ($record === null) {
            return [];
        }

        $status = $record->getAttribute('status');
        $readyAt = $record->getAttribute('ready_at');
        $payload = $record->getAttribute($payloadField);

        return [
            $outputType,
            is_object($status) && property_exists($status, 'value') ? (string) $status->value : (string) $status,
            (string) ($record->getAttribute('prompt_version') ?? ''),
            (string) ($record->getAttribute('model_id') ?? ''),
            $readyAt instanceof Carbon ? $readyAt->toIso8601String() : '',
            is_array($payload) ? json_encode($payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE) ?: '' : (string) ($payload ?? ''),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function headers(EventExportType $type): array
    {
        $headers = __('events.exports.headers.'.$type->value);

        return is_array($headers) ? array_values(array_map('strval', $headers)) : [];
    }

    private function safeFilenameStem(Event $event): string
    {
        $slug = str((string) $event->title)->slug('-')->toString();

        return $slug !== '' ? $slug : 'event-'.$event->id;
    }

    private function hasEntitlement(User $actor, Event $event, PlanEntitlement $entitlement): bool
    {
        return $this->entitlements->hasFreshEntitlementForTeam($actor, $event->team_id, $entitlement);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventType;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<Event>
 */
class EventFactory extends Factory
{
    protected $model = Event::class;

    public function definition(): array
    {
        $startsAt = $this->faker->dateTimeBetween('+1 day', '+60 days');
        $endsAt = (clone $startsAt)->modify('+1 hour');

        return [
            'uuid' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'team_id' => Team::factory(),
            'state' => EventState::DRAFT->value,
            'title' => $this->faker->sentence(4),
            'description' => $this->faker->paragraph(),
            // Produces a string; Eloquent's EventType cast hydrates it to an enum
            // instance on the model (both make() and create() go through the cast).
            'type' => $this->faker->randomElement(EventType::cases())->value,
            'starts_at' => $startsAt,
            'ends_at' => $endsAt,
            'timezone' => 'UTC',
            'created_by' => User::factory(),
        ];
    }

    public function withLanding(string $template = 'classic'): self
    {
        return $this->afterCreating(function (Event $event) use ($template) {
            if (!$event->landingPage()->exists()) {
                \App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage::forceCreate([
                    'event_id' => $event->id,
                    'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                    'template' => $template,
                    'primary_color' => '#8B2323',
                ]);
            }
        });
    }

    public function inState(EventState $state): self
    {
        return $this->state(fn () => ['state' => $state->value]);
    }

class ScratchTest extends FeatureTestCase

    public function explore_system_admin_without_event_capability(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();

        $role = Role::create([
            'name' => 'Platform Support Desk',
            'key' => 'platform_support_desk',
            'is_system_admin' => true,
        ]);
        $role->assignPermission('users.viewany.global');

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'current_team_id' => $workspace->id,
        ]);
        $workspace->users()->attach($user, ['role' => $role->key]);
        $user = $user->fresh(['currentTeam']);

        dump([
            'isSystemAdmin' => $user->isSystemAdmin(),
            'bypass' => $user->shouldBypassTeamScope(),
            'eventsViewGlobal' => Gate::forUser($user)->allows('events.view.global'),
            'usersViewAnyGlobal' => Gate::forUser($user)->allows('users.viewany.global'),
        ]);

        $dash = $this->actingAs($user)->get(route('admin.dashboard'));
        dump(['admin.dashboard' => $dash->getStatusCode()]);

        $this->app['auth']->forgetGuards();

        $idx = $this->actingAs($user)->get(route('admin.events.index'));
        dump(['admin.events.index' => $idx->getStatusCode()]);

        $this->assertTrue(true);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function explore_registration_creation_and_super_admin(): void
    {
        $workspaceA = $this->createWorkspace(['name' => 'Alpha Workspace']);
        $workspaceB = $this->createWorkspace(['name' => 'Beta Workspace']);

        $eventA = Event::factory()->for($workspaceA)->create(['title' => 'Alpha Summit']);
        $eventB = Event::factory()->for($workspaceB)->create(['title' => 'Beta Summit']);

        $reg = Registration::unguarded(fn (): Registration => Registration::query()->create([
            'team_id' => $eventB->team_id,
            'event_id' => $eventB->id,
            'email' => 'beta-person@example.test',
            'email_hash' => hash('sha256', 'beta-person@example.test'),
            'source' => 'direct',
            'full_name' => 'Beta Person',
            'consent_accepted_at' => now(),
        ]));

        dump([
            'regTeam' => $reg->team_id,
            'eventBTeam' => $eventB->team_id,
            'eventAUuid' => $eventA->uuid,
            'routeKey' => $eventA->getRouteKey(),
        ]);

        $admin = $this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspaceA);
        dump([
            'admin bypass' => $admin->shouldBypassTeamScope(),
            'admin events.view.global' => Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('events.view.global'),
            'existing tenant export route' => route('events.exports.show', [$eventA, 'registrants']),
        ]);

        $resp = $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('admin.events.show', $eventB));
        dump(['admin.events.show cross-workspace' => $resp->getStatusCode()]);

        $this->assertTrue(true);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function explore_workspace_admin_capabilities(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();

            'admin events.view.global' => Gate::forUser($member)->allows('events.view.global'),

        ]);

        $this->assertTrue(true);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\AtddOracle;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Role;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\TestDox;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\BinaryFileResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support\InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

/**
 * Behavioural checks for the platform-admin registration export endpoint.
 *
 * Only public seams are used: the named route, the route-permission map,
 * persisted registrations, HTTP status codes and the delivered payload.
 */
class OracleTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    private const EXPORT_ROUTE = 'admin.events.registrations.export';

    /**
     * The global capability that already governs platform-wide event visibility.
     */
    private const GLOBAL_EVENT_VISIBILITY = 'events.view.global';

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Scope of the exported data
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('The export lists the requested event registrations and nothing from another event')]
    public function export_contains_only_the_requested_events_registrations(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace(['name' => 'Northwind Workspace']);
        $subject = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Northwind Delivery Review');
        $neighbour = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Northwind Product Roadmap');

        $wanted = [
            $this->registerAttendee($subject, 'Nadia Osterlund', 'nadia.osterlund@example.test'),
            $this->registerAttendee($subject, 'Priya Vasquez', 'priya.vasquez@example.test'),
        ];
        $unwanted = $this->registerAttendee($neighbour, 'Tomas Lindqvist', 'tomas.lindqvist@example.test');

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace))
            ->get($this->exportUrl($subject));

        $response->assertOk();

        $csv = $this->payloadOf($response);

        foreach ($wanted as $attendee) {
            $this->assertAttendeeListed($csv, $attendee);
        }

        $this->assertAttendeeAbsent(
            $csv,
            $unwanted,
            'The export must not contain registrations that belong to a different event.',
        );
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('The export returns the registrations of an event that lives in another workspace')]
    public function export_returns_registrations_for_an_event_in_another_workspace(): void
    {
        $homeWorkspace = $this->createWorkspace(['name' => 'Platform Support Desk']);
        $reportedWorkspace = $this->createWorkspace(['name' => 'Customer Workspace']);

        $reportedEvent = $this->eventFor($reportedWorkspace, 'Customer Quarterly Briefing');
        $attendee = $this->registerAttendee($reportedEvent, 'Ilse Brandhorst', 'ilse.brandhorst@example.test');

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($homeWorkspace))
            ->get($this->exportUrl($reportedEvent));

        $response->assertOk();

        $this->assertAttendeeListed(
            $this->payloadOf($response),
            $attendee,
            'A platform-wide export must return the registrations of the requested event even when '
            .'the event belongs to a workspace other than the exporting admin current workspace.',
        );
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Authorization
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('An admin-area user without the global event-visibility capability is refused')]
    public function admin_area_user_without_global_event_capability_cannot_export(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Restricted Delivery Review');
        $attendee = $this->registerAttendee($event, 'Marika Sunndal', 'marika.sunndal@example.test');

        $actor = $this->adminAreaUserWithoutEventVisibility($workspace);

<?php

namespace Tests;

use App\Modules\Billing\Providers\Mock\MockPaymentProvider;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Providers\Mock\MockLiveBroadcastProvider;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Providers\Mock\MockStreamingProvider;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Http;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    use CreatesApplication;

    /**
     * Setup the test environment
     */
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        // R6-H1 + R7-M4: reset MockPaymentProvider static `$orderStates`
        // BEFORE parent::setUp() runs trait hooks. Some trait setUp paths
        // (e.g., afterApplicationCreated) seed mock state — if we cleared
        // AFTER parent::setUp() we would silently wipe their stubs.
        // Clearing first leaves a clean slate for both base + trait setUp
        // and the per-test setUp body.
        MockPaymentProvider::clearOrderStates();
        MockStreamingProvider::resetFailures();
        MockLiveBroadcastProvider::reset();

        parent::setUp();

        // Disable Vite asset loading during tests. Without a compiled
        // manifest (public/build/manifest.json) the @vite Blade directive
        // throws, causing ~118 tests to fail. This is the standard Laravel
        // approach for running tests without a front-end build step.
        $this->withoutVite();

        // Prevent any test from making real HTTP requests accidentally.
        // Tests that need HTTP should explicitly call Http::fake() with
        // their expected responses. This catches forgotten fakes that
        // would otherwise cause slow timeouts or flaky tests.
        Http::preventStrayRequests();
    }
}

# SuperAdmin Module — Agent Rules

## Canonical specs to read BEFORE editing

- `docs/specs/roles-permissions.md` — SYSTEM_ADMIN two-cap rule and capability naming conventions.
- `docs/handbook/08_Platform_Packages/Authz_Package.md` — how `*.global` capabilities work and why they bypass team scope.
- `docs/handbook/01_Architecture_and_Concepts/TeamScope_Bypass_Convention.md` — when `withoutGlobalScope(TeamScope::class)` is legitimate and when it is redundant.
- `_bmad-output/planning-artifacts/epics.md` — Epic 9 story scope (Super Admin & Platform Ops).

## BMAD workflow fidelity

If a BMAD skill is named or required by the active flow, follow the real skill workflow. Do not substitute a hand-written artifact and do not mark the phase complete until the required skill outputs exist on disk.

## Hard rules

1. **No direct Eloquent queries in Livewire components.** No `Model::query()`, `::where()`, `::find()`, `->paginate()`, or `DB::table()` in any Livewire component — even reads. All data access goes through `SuperAdminWorkspaceService` or the focused billing services.

2. **SYSTEM_ADMIN two-cap rule.** Every destructive Super Admin action requires a dedicated `*.global` capability (e.g., `teams.suspend.global`, `billing.credit.global`, `users.impersonate.global`). Never gate on role name alone (`if ($user->isSystemAdmin())`). Always check the capability via `Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('capability.name')`.

3. **All business logic in services.** Controllers stay thin: validate input, call `SuperAdminWorkspaceService` or the relevant focused billing service, return redirect. No domain logic in controllers or Livewire components.

4. **Audit every destructive action.** Workspace suspend, reactivate, ownership transfer, subscription credit, refund, and void must each emit an audit log row via the `AuditLoggerInterface`. The audit row must be written in the same `DB::transaction()` as the state change.

5. **Impersonation scope is read-only by default.** The `users.impersonate.global` capability grants impersonation entry. Any action that would write state while impersonating must be explicitly checked and refused unless the story spec authorises it.

6. **Do NOT bypass `TeamScope` for SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team work.** SYSTEM_ADMIN cross-team access is already handled at the scope layer by `User::shouldBypassTeamScope()` — duplicating the bypass at the service / repository layer is redundant and weakens the safety posture. Legitimate bypasses are narrow and must be documented:
   - **Category A — public visitor / anonymous surfaces** (no tenant context exists; replace authz with a business-rule guard such as a signed URL or visibility check).
   - **Category B — cron / queue / console with no actor** (no tenant context exists; the work is system-driven).
   - **Category C/E — relation helpers, route resolution, transaction locks, or provider/job continuations** only when focused tests prove the flow breaks without the bypass and the waiver file records that evidence.

   If you find yourself wanting to bypass for anything else, stop and read `docs/handbook/01_Architecture_and_Concepts/TeamScope_Bypass_Convention.md`. For future global-cap roles, extend `User::shouldBypassTeamScope()`, not the service.

   When bypass IS legitimate, authorise (or apply the equivalent business-rule guard) **before** the bypass, never after. The Tenancy bypass test gate (see `notes/story-draft-tenancy-bypass-guardrail.md` once landed) enforces this in CI; new bypass sites must either include a recognised authz token in the method body or appear in the waiver file with a category justification and focused test evidence.

7. **No direct subscription writes from SuperAdmin controllers.** All subscription mutations (credit, refund, adjustment void) go through `ManualAdjustmentService` or the relevant focused billing service. The controller passes validated payload to the service and handles the redirect.

8. **Capability via Authz package.** Routes use `route.permission` middleware + `config/route_permissions.php`. Never write a custom `Ensure*` middleware or `abort_if` role check — use the gate.

9. **Module views.** All views live under `app/Modules/SuperAdmin/Resources/views/`. Render with `view('super-admin::...')`. No views under `resources/views/admin/`.

10. **i18n.** All user-facing strings via `__('super-admin::super-admin.*')`. Keys must exist in both `lang/en/` and `lang/tr/` (module-namespaced).

class RoleActionController
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly SuperAdminRoleService $service,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Show the permission-matrix editor for a role.
     *
     * SYSTEM_ADMIN is rendered read-only (no form).
     * Non-system roles render an editable permission-matrix form.
     */
    public function show(string $roleUuid): View
    {
        $role = $this->service->findByUuidOrFail($roleUuid);

        // Eager-load the permission count so the view uses $role->permissions_count
        // (avoiding an N+1 per-render query).
        $role->loadCount('permissions');

        // Group available permissions by resource for the matrix view.
        // AC2 scope filter: SYSTEM_ADMIN (is_system_admin=true) sees global-only permissions;
        // all other roles see non-global (team-scoped) permissions only.
        // Keyed on is_system_admin per Dev Notes flag-precision rule.
        $allPermissions = PermissionRegistry::allWithSystem();
        $permissionsByResource = [];
        foreach ($allPermissions as $permission) {
            $isGlobal = PermissionRegistry::isGlobalPermission($permission);
            // Skip permissions whose scope does not match this role type.
            if ($role->is_system_admin && ! $isGlobal) {
                continue;
            }
            if (! $role->is_system_admin && $isGlobal) {
                continue;
            }
            [$resource] = PermissionRegistry::parsePermission($permission);
            if ($resource !== null) {
                $permissionsByResource[$resource][] = $permission;
            }
        }
        ksort($permissionsByResource);

        return view('super-admin::roles.show', compact('role', 'permissionsByResource'));
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\SuperAdmin\Services;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;

/**
 * Platform support export of a single event's registration list.
 *
 * The query is scoped to the requested event and nothing else. Cross-workspace
 * reach is already handled at the scope layer (User::shouldBypassTeamScope), so
 * no TeamScope bypass is repeated here per the SuperAdmin module rules.
 */
class AdminEventRegistrationExportService
{
    public function response(Event $event): StreamedResponse
    {
        $rows = $this->rows($event);

        return response()->streamDownload(function () use ($rows): void {
            $handle = fopen('php://output', 'wb');
            if ($handle === false) {
                return;
            }

            foreach ($rows as $row) {
                fputcsv($handle, $row, escape: '\\');
            }

            fclose($handle);
        }, $this->filename($event), [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8',
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<list<string>>
     */
    public function rows(Event $event): array
    {
        $rows = [$this->headers()];

        /** @var Collection<int, Registration> $registrations */
        $registrations = Registration::query()
            ->where('event_id', $event->id)
            ->orderBy('created_at')
            ->orderBy('id')
            ->get();

        foreach ($registrations as $registration) {
            $rows[] = [
                (string) $registration->full_name,
                (string) $registration->email,
                (string) ($registration->company ?? ''),
                (string) ($registration->country ?? ''),
                (string) $registration->source,
                $registration->consent_accepted_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',
                $registration->created_at?->toIso8601String() ?? '',
            ];
        }

        return $rows;
    }

    public function filename(Event $event): string
    {
        $stem = Str::slug((string) $event->title);

        if ($stem === '') {
            $stem = 'event-'.$event->id;
        }

        return sprintf('%s-%s-registrations.csv', $stem, (string) $event->uuid);
    }

    /**
     * @return list<string>
     */
    private function headers(): array
    {
        $headers = __('super-admin::super-admin.events.registration_export.headers');

        return is_array($headers) ? array_values(array_map('strval', $headers)) : [];
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Registration;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Testing\TestResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\TestDox;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\StreamedResponse;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;
use Tests\Feature\SuperAdmin\Support\InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

/**
 * Platform-admin export of a single event's registration list.
 */
class AdminEventRegistrationExportTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use InteractsWithSuperAdmin;

    private const ROUTE = 'admin.events.registrations.export';

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC1/AC5 — a platform admin downloads the registration list as CSV')]
    public function platform_admin_downloads_the_registration_csv(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Spring Product Briefing');
        $this->registerAttendee($event, 'Dana Whitfield', 'dana.whitfield@example.test');

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace))
            ->get(route(self::ROUTE, $event));

        $response->assertOk();

        $disposition = (string) $response->headers->get('content-disposition');
        $this->assertStringContainsString('attachment', $disposition);
        $this->assertStringContainsString(Str::slug((string) $event->title), $disposition);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('csv', strtolower((string) $response->headers->get('content-type').$disposition));

        $this->assertStringContainsString('Dana Whitfield', $this->csvOf($response));
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC4 — the export contains no registrations from another event')]
    public function export_excludes_registrations_of_other_events(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $wanted = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Wanted Event');
        $other = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Other Event');

        $this->registerAttendee($wanted, 'Kai Rehnberg', 'kai.rehnberg@example.test');
        $this->registerAttendee($other, 'Mira Halloway', 'mira.halloway@example.test');

        $response = $this->actingAs($this->createPlatformSuperAdmin($workspace))
            ->get(route(self::ROUTE, $wanted));

        $response->assertOk();

        $csv = $this->csvOf($response);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('Kai Rehnberg', $csv);
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Mira Halloway', $csv);
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC3 — a workspace administrator is refused and receives no CSV')]
    public function workspace_administrator_is_refused(): void
    {
        $workspace = $this->createWorkspace();
        $event = $this->eventFor($workspace, 'Gated Event');
        $this->registerAttendee($event, 'Ruth Bellamy', 'ruth.bellamy@example.test');

        $member = $this->createWorkspaceMember($workspace, UserRole::ADMIN);

        $response = $this->actingAs($member)->get(route(self::ROUTE, $event));

        $response->assertForbidden();
        $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Ruth Bellamy', (string) $response->getContent());
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC2 — the route is gated through the route-permission configuration')]
    public function route_is_mapped_in_the_route_permission_configuration(): void
    {
        $mappings = config('route_permissions.routes');

        $this->assertArrayHasKey(self::ROUTE, $mappings);
        $this->assertNotNull($mappings[self::ROUTE]);
        $this->assertNotSame('__public__', $mappings[self::ROUTE]);
    }

    #[Test]
    #[TestDox('AC6 — pre-existing admin permission entries are untouched')]
    public function pre_existing_admin_permission_entries_are_unchanged(): void
    {
        $mappings = config('route_permissions.routes');

        $this->assertSame('events.view.global', $mappings['admin.events.index']);
        $this->assertSame('events.view.global', $mappings['admin.events.show']);
        $this->assertSame('events.update.global', $mappings['admin.events.edit']);
        $this->assertSame('system_admin_access', $mappings['admin.dashboard']);
        $this->assertSame('users.viewany.global', $mappings['admin.users.index']);
    }

    private function eventFor(Team $workspace, string $title): Event
    {
        return Event::factory()->for($workspace)->create(['title' => $title]);
    }

    private function registerAttendee(Event $event, string $fullName, string $email): void
    {
        Registration::unguarded(function () use ($event, $fullName, $email): void {
            Registration::query()->create([
                'team_id' => $event->team_id,
                'event_id' => $event->id,
                'email' => $email,
                'email_hash' => hash('sha256', $email),
                'source' => 'direct',
                'full_name' => $fullName,
                'consent_accepted_at' => now(),
            ]);
        });
    }

    private function csvOf(TestResponse $response): string
    {
        $base = $response->baseResponse;

        if ($base instanceof StreamedResponse) {
            ob_start();
            $base->sendContent();

            return (string) ob_get_clean();
        }

        return (string) $base->getContent();
    }
}
